name: Broccoli Florets with Vegan Cashew "Caesar" Dip
instructions: Wash, dry, and juice lemons into a blender.

Peel garlic; add to the blender along with cashews, water, nutritional yeast, capers, soy sauce, Dijon, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding additional water, 1-2 tablespoons at a time, if needed, to make a smooth dip.
Divide broccoli florets between plates; serve with dip on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
